legend: This is an interactive problem.

A city has n2$$$n^2$$$ buildings divided into a grid of n$$$n$$$ rows and n$$$n$$$ columns. You need to build a road of some length D(A,B)$$$D(A,B)$$$ of your choice between each pair of adjacent by side buildings A$$$A$$$ and B$$$B$$$. Due to budget limitations and legal restrictions, the length of each road must be a positive integer and the total length of all roads should not exceed 48000$$$48\,000$$$.

There is a thief in the city who will start from the topmost, leftmost building (in the first row and the first column) and roam around the city, occasionally stealing artifacts from some of the buildings. He can move from one building to another adjacent building by travelling through the road which connects them.

You are unable to track down what buildings he visits and what path he follows to reach them. But there is one tracking mechanism in the city. The tracker is capable of storing a single integer x$$$x$$$ which is initially 0$$$0$$$. Each time the thief travels from a building A$$$A$$$ to another adjacent building B$$$B$$$ through a road of length D(A,B)$$$D(A,B)$$$, the tracker changes x$$$x$$$ to x⊕D(A,B)$$$x\oplus D(A,B)$$$. Each time the thief steals from a building, the tracker reports the value x$$$x$$$ stored in it and resets it back to 0$$$0$$$.

It is known beforehand that the thief will steal in exactly k$$$k$$$ buildings but you will know the values returned by the tracker only after the thefts actually happen. Your task is to choose the lengths of roads in such a way that no matter what strategy or routes the thief follows, you will be able to exactly tell the location of all the buildings where the thefts occurred from the values returned by the tracker.
Interaction
First read a single line containing two integers n$$$n$$$ (2≤n≤32)$$$(2\leq n\leq 32)$$$ and k$$$k$$$ (1≤k≤1024)$$$(1\leq k\leq 1024)$$$ denoting the number of rows and number of thefts respectively.
Let's denote the j$$$j$$$-th building in the i$$$i$$$-th row by Bi,j$$$B_{i,j}$$$.
Then print n$$$n$$$ lines each containing n−1$$$n-1$$$ integers. The j$$$j$$$-th integer of the i$$$i$$$-th line must be the value of D(Bi,j,Bi,j+1)$$$D(B_{i,j},B_{i,j+1})$$$.
Then print n−1$$$n-1$$$ lines each containing n$$$n$$$ integers. The j$$$j$$$-th integer of the i$$$i$$$-th line must be the value of D(Bi,j,Bi+1,j)$$$D(B_{i,j},B_{i+1,j})$$$.
Remember that the total length of the roads must not exceed 48000$$$48\,000$$$.

Then answer k$$$k$$$ queries. First read the value x$$$x$$$ returned by the tracker. Then print two integers denoting the row number and column number of the building where the theft occurred. After that you will be able to answer the next query (if such exists).
After printing the answers do not forget to output end of line and flush the output buffer. Otherwise you will get the verdict Idleness limit exceeded. To flush the buffer, use:
fflush(stdout) or cout.flush() in C++;
System.out.flush() in Java;
flush(output) in Pascal;
stdout.flush() in Python;
Read documentation for other languages.
Hacks
You cannot make hacks in this problem.

legend.ai: 这是一道交互题。
一座城市有 n2$$$n^2$$$ 座建筑物，它们被划分为 n$$$n$$$ 行、n$$$n$$$ 列的网格。你需要在每一对上下或左右相邻的建筑物 A$$$A$$$ 和 B$$$B$$$ 之间修建一条长度为 D(A,B)$$$D(A,B)$$$ 的道路，长度由你自行决定。由于预算限制和法律规定，每条道路的长度必须为正整数，且所有道路的总长度不得超过 48000$$$48\,000$$$。
城市中有一名小偷，他将从最上方、最左侧的建筑物（第一行第一列）出发，在城市中四处游荡，并偶尔从某些建筑物中偷取文物。他可以通过连接两座相邻建筑物的道路，从一座建筑物移动到另一座建筑物。

你无法追踪他会光顾哪些建筑物，也无法得知他前往这些建筑物时所经过的路径。不过，城市中有一种追踪装置。该装置能够存储一个整数 x$$$x$$$，其初始值为 0$$$0$$$。每当小偷从建筑物 A$$$A$$$ 经过一条长度为 D(A,B)$$$D(A,B)$$$ 的道路前往另一栋相邻建筑物 B$$$B$$$ 时，追踪装置会将 x$$$x$$$ 变为 x⊕D(A,B)$$$x\oplus D(A,B)$$$。每当小偷从一栋建筑物中盗窃时，追踪装置会报告其中存储的值 x$$$x$$$，并将其重置为 0$$$0$$$。
事先已知小偷将恰好在 k$$$k$$$ 栋建筑物中进行盗窃，但只有在盗窃实际发生后，你才能知道追踪装置返回的值。你的任务是选择道路的长度，使得无论小偷采取何种策略、经过何种路径，你都能根据追踪装置返回的值，准确确定所有发生盗窃的建筑物的位置。
交互
首先读取一行，其中包含两个整数 n$$$n$$$(2≤n≤32)$$$(2\leq n\leq 32)$$$ 和 k$$$k$$$(1≤k≤1024)$$$(1\leq k\leq 1024)$$$，分别表示行数和盗窃次数。
记第 i$$$i$$$ 行中的第 j$$$j$$$ 栋建筑物为 Bi,j$$$B_{i,j}$$$。
然后输出 n$$$n$$$ 行，每行包含 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 个整数。第 i$$$i$$$ 行中的第 j$$$j$$$ 个整数必须为 D(Bi,j,Bi,j+1)$$$D(B_{i,j},B_{i,j+1})$$$ 的值。
然后输出 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 行，每行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数。第 i$$$i$$$ 行的第 j$$$j$$$ 个整数必须是 D(Bi,j,Bi+1,j)$$$D(B_{i,j},B_{i+1,j})$$$ 的值。
然后回答 k$$$k$$$ 个查询。首先读入追踪器返回的值 x$$$x$$$。然后输出发生盗窃的建筑所在的行号和列号，共两个整数。之后你就可以回答下一个查询(如果存在)。
输出答案后，不要忘记输出换行符并刷新输出缓冲区。否则你将得到 Idleness limit exceeded 判定。要刷新缓冲区，请使用：
在 C++ 中使用 fflush(stdout) 或 cout.flush()；
在 Java 中使用 System.out.flush()。
Pascal 中的 flush(output)；
Python 中的 stdout.flush()；
请阅读其他语言的文档。
Hack
你不能在本题中进行 Hack。
